definitions.gloss: the month before last; two months ago
definitions.explanation: Refers to the month two months before the current one. Formed by doubling the {先|せん} in {先月|せんげつ} (last month).

examples.japanese: {先々月|せんせんげつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
{先々月|せんせんげつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started preparing the month before last.

examples.japanese: {先々月|せんせんげつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}かった→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The electricity bill from the month before last was higher than usual.

notes:
Formed by doubling {先|せん} in ⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧ (last month). This doubling pattern is productive in Japanese time words.

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- ⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧: last month
- {先々月|せんせんげつ}: the month before last
- ⟦{先週|せんしゅう}→先週：00752_senshuu⟧: last week
- ⟦{先々週|せんせんしゅう}→先々週：11496_sensenshuu⟧: the week before last
- {一昨年|おととし}: the year before last (note: uses a different pattern)

USAGE:
Functions as a time noun that can modify verbs directly without a particle, or take ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to modify another noun: {先々月|せんせんげつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ (sales from the month before last). For months further back, use ～か{月前|げつまえ}: ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月前|げつまえ} (three months ago).
